item.name: Gems
item.source: Story mode, challenges, quests, achievements, codes, events, and Beginner Path
item.use: Main summon currency for unit banners
item.cardSummary: Primary premium-style currency spent on banners to pull units.

item.name: Gold
item.source: Story mode, challenges, quests, daily activities, events, and selling shiny units
item.use: Buy Gold Shop goods, cosmetics, and other shop items
item.cardSummary: Soft currency used for the Gold Shop, cosmetics, and many upgrade costs.

item.name: Event Coins
item.use: Spend in the event shop
item.cardSummary: Limited event currency for buying progression items from the event shop.

item.name: Expedition Coins
item.use: Spend in the Expedition Shop
item.cardSummary: Expedition event currency for the Expedition Shop progression track.

item.name: Crown
item.use: Spend in the tournament shop
item.cardSummary: Tournament reward currency used in the tournament shop.

item.name: Fuel Cells
item.use: Expedition-exclusive resource earned from event nodes
item.cardSummary: Expedition event resource gained by completing event nodes.

item.name: Spirit Tokens
item.use: Buy items from the Spirit Society raid shop
item.cardSummary: Raid token currency for the Spirit Society / Spirit City raid shop.

item.name: Raid Tokens
item.use: Buy items from the general raid shop
item.cardSummary: General raid token currency for the main raid shop.

item.name: Trait Crystal
item.source: Quests, star missions, challenges, tournaments, achievements, codes, bundles, shops, and Time Chamber
item.use: Reroll a unit's trait for stronger passive bonuses
item.cardSummary: Consumable used at the Trait Reroll stand to roll a new trait on a unit.

item.name: Stat Reroll
item.source: Quests, rewards, event shop, challenges, bundles, and Gold Shop
item.use: Reroll a unit's damage, range, and SPA potential stats
item.cardSummary: Consumable that rerolls a unit's potential tiers for damage, SPA, and range.

item.name: Stat Lock
item.source: Event shop, Gold Shop, challenges, bundles, and other shops
item.use: Lock one unit stat potential while rerolling the rest
item.cardSummary: Protects a chosen potential stat so it stays fixed during a Stat Reroll.

item.name: Equipment Reroll
item.source: Challenges, event shop, Gold Shop (about 2500 Gold), raid shops, and bundles
item.use: Reroll an equipment piece's potential stats
item.cardSummary: Consumable that randomizes potential rolls on equipped gear. Available from challenges and the Gold Shop.

item.name: Equipment Lock
item.source: Event shop, Gold Shop, challenges, raid shops, and bundles
item.use: Lock one equipment potential stat while rerolling
item.cardSummary: Keeps a chosen equipment potential locked so other stats can be rerolled safely.

item.name: Grey Sprites
item.source: Story stages, farming, challenges, and rewards
item.use: Base craft material for higher-tier colored and rainbow sprites
item.cardSummary: Core sprite material farmed from content and converted into color sprites at the Crafting Station.

item.name: Blue Sprites
item.source: Crafted at the Crafting Station from Grey Sprites; also challenges
item.use: Unit evolution, equipment crafting
item.cardSummary: Blue craft sprite used in many unit evolutions and equipment crafts.

item.name: Green Sprites
item.source: Crafted at the Crafting Station from Grey Sprites; also challenges
item.use: Unit evolution, equipment crafting, and ascension
item.cardSummary: Green craft sprite spent on evolutions, equipment crafts, and ascension costs.

item.source: Crafted at the Crafting Station from Grey Sprites; also challenges
item.use: Unit evolution
item.cardSummary: Pink craft sprite required for several unit evolution recipes.

item.name: Purple Sprites
item.source: Crafted at the Crafting Station from Grey Sprites; also challenges

item.cardSummary: Stronger paid summon boost potion for higher-tier unit odds.

item.name: Spirit City Totem

item.cardSummary: Raid shop buff item that grants a 10% damage boost during Spirit City raids.
